summary: terminal_full.py: CLI requires repository root and plan dir; validates R0-R4 or one slice; registered commands are allowlisted by registry id/executable/argv and repo-contained cwd; full requires terminal receipts and resume state; validates plan state, maintainer authorization binding, knowledge context/freeze, skill-input receipt/current contract; full binds required artifacts plus ready non-authorizing skill receipt; candidate hash covers HEAD, binary diff, relevant untracked content excluding generated paths; emits non-authorizing terminal result with hashes/selectors/failures; exit 0 only on no failures; ambiguities: contract/registry files are read before existence/JSON handling, so malformed/missing inputs raise rather than structured failure; receipt selection uses newest mtime.
